title: Thai-Style Gluten-Free Tofu Curry
description: A flavorful and spicy Thai-inspired dish made with pan-seared tofu and a blend of aromatic spices, all served over a bed of fluffy rice.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the curry paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes.
Add the coconut milk, fish sauce, brown sugar, and curry powder. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the tofu and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes, or until heated through.
Stir in the Thai basil and zesty lime juice.
Serve the curry over a bed of fluffy rice.
Garnish with additional Thai basil leaves, if desired.
